liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Playin' In The Band** (1 review): Listener describes the version of Playin' In The Band as completely out [15]
- **Sugar Magnolia** (1 review): Listener calls this one of the best Sugar Magnolia performances heard [17]

## The recordings

- **gd1972-09-28.sbd.bertha.34162.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 32 songs; 215 min; rated 5/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd1972-09-28.sbd.bertha.ashley.27584.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 32 songs; 215 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd72-09-28.sbd-patched.chrisl.26933.sbeok.flacf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 31 songs; 222 min; rated 4.09/5 by 11 [3]. Said about its sound: Loser lacks a vocal track for approximately five minutes and forty seconds; Loser has painful cuts and missing vocals, disrupting flow into the next song [19][23]
- **gd72-09-28.sbd.bill.12657.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 30 songs; 213 min; rated 4.91/5 by 43 [4]. Said about its sound: Listener notes the soundboard recording has low quality; Loser contains some soundboard recording problems; Bob Weir is high in the mix, showcasing rhythmic prowess [13][14][16][24]
- **gd1972-09-28.sbd.miller.94268.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 30 songs; 214 min; rated 5/5 by 11 [5]

## Around the show

- Listener prefers this show over the previous night's Dick's Picks release [14]
- Show exemplifies the band maintaining intense energy levels across consecutive nights [20]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1972-09-28.sbd.bertha.34162.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Bertha Remaster of the patched master reel source; source: SBD->MR->DAT->CDA->WAV->SHN->FLAC [1]. Also: Source lineage includes unknown audience tape, cassette, DAT, WAV, and FLAC [1]
- **gd1972-09-28.sbd.bertha.ashley.27584.sbefail.shnf**: taped by Unknown; transferred by J. Ashely; source: SBD > Master Reel [2]. Also: Digitally remastered using a custom dual-DAW system nicknamed Bertha [2]
- **gd72-09-28.sbd-patched.chrisl.26933.sbeok.flacf**: source: Soundboard with Audience patches [3]
- **gd72-09-28.sbd.bill.12657.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [4]
- **gd1972-09-28.sbd.miller.94268.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD [5]. Also: First few notes of Bertha are cut in this version [5]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by johnsdeadart.blogspot.com: [John's Custom Grateful Dead Album Cover Art](https://johnsdeadart.blogspot.com/2017/05/blog-post_90.html) [26]
